description: This file defines a package 'fields' that implements a selector system for filtering objects based on field criteria. It includes interfaces, concrete types, parsing, and utility functions for field selectors used in Kubernetes API machinery.

classes.name: nothingSelector
classes.description: A selector that matches no fields.

classes.name: hasTerm
classes.description: Represents a field that must match a specific value.

classes.name: notHasTerm
classes.description: Represents a field that must not match a specific value.

classes.name: andTerm
classes.description: A composite selector representing a logical AND of multiple selectors.

classes.name: InvalidEscapeSequence
classes.description: Error indicating an invalid escape sequence during unescaping.

classes.name: UnescapedRune
classes.description: Error indicating an unescaped special character in a value.

methods.name: Nothing
methods.description: Returns a selector that matches no fields.

methods.name: Everything
methods.description: Returns a selector that matches all fields.

methods.name: SelectorFromSet
methods.description: Creates a selector matching exactly the given set of field-value pairs.

methods.name: EscapeValue
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for use as a field selector value.

methods.name: UnescapeValue
methods.description: Unescapes a field selector value to its original literal form.

methods.name: ParseSelectorOrDie
methods.description: Parses a selector string or panics on error.

methods.name: ParseSelector
methods.description: Parses a selector string into a Selector object.

methods.name: ParseAndTransformSelector
methods.description: Parses a selector string and applies a transformation function.

methods.name: OneTermEqualSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector matching a single field equal to a value.

methods.name: OneTermNotEqualSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector matching a single field not equal to a value.

methods.name: AndSelectors
methods.description: Creates a composite selector that ANDs multiple selectors.
